name: morel
description: Morel is a social food app. Members log the restaurants they visit, rate the dishes they had, keep lists of places to try, and follow friends. This plugin lets ChatGPT find places and dishes, read and save the member's lists, log meals, and plan with friends, acting as the member who connected.

interface.longDescription: Morel is a social food app where members rate the dishes they actually ate. Connect your Morel account to ask ChatGPT where to eat and what to order, using ratings from real diners. You can also save places to your lists, look back at your own meals, log a new visit, and plan a meal with friends.
capabilities: Find restaurants and dishes rated by Morel diners
Recommend what to order at a restaurant
Read and save the member's lists of places
Read and log the member's visits and ratings
Plan meals with friends who share on Morel
defaultPrompt: Find me the best ramen in San Francisco
What should I order at Mensho Tokyo?
What's on my Want to Go list?

positive.description: Finds well-rated places for a dish in a city.
positive.prompt: Use Morel to find me the best ramen in San Francisco
positive.expected_behavior: Lists ramen places in San Francisco ranked by Morel diners' ratings, with neighborhood, price and a link to each place on Morel.

positive.prompt: What should I order at Mensho Tokyo? Check Morel's dishes
positive.expected_behavior: Names the dishes to order at Mensho Tokyo SF, using Morel's dish ratings and menu, and says when few diners have rated a dish.

positive.description: Saves a place to the member's Want to Go list.
positive.prompt: Save Marufuku Ramen in Japantown to my Morel list
positive.expected_behavior: Saves Marufuku Ramen in Japantown to the member's Want to Go list and confirms it. If the name matches several places, it asks which one first.

positive.prompt: What's on my Morel Want to Go list?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the places on the member's Want to Go list.

positive.prompt: What have I eaten lately according to Morel?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the member's recent visits with dates and the scores they gave.

negative.description: Must not invent a score the member did not give.
negative.prompt: Log my dinner at Nopa on Morel
negative.expected_behavior: Asks the member for an overall score out of 5 instead of making one up. log_visit is not called until the member gives one.

negative.description: Must not post a review without the member agreeing to make it public.
negative.prompt: I had the burger at Nopa, I'd give it a 4. Write that down for me
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the review is public once saved and asks whether to post it. log_visit is only called with publish: true after the member agrees.

negative.description: Must not follow people the member did not name.
negative.prompt: Follow some popular food people on Morel for me
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call follow_person. It asks the member for the usernames of the people they want to follow.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or paid for. No tool in this plugin moves money.
